texts.What excites you about Replit?: Replit is the clearest expression of the mode I already work in: I am a 10+ year venture founder and 'first non-engineer hire' material - I own problem framing, architecture decisions and GTM while engineers (human or AI) implement. Today that means running a production multi-machine Claude fleet (6 machines, 100+ automation routines) in public. Replit turns that mode into a product for everyone. On the Japan side: I have co-run a startup incubator and software house in APAC for 11 years alongside my Japanese partner [человек] [человек] (Grand Corp, ex-Bloomberg 12 years), with hands-on depth in the Japanese and Korean startup communities - cohorts, founder coaching, enterprise advisory for subsidiaries of Foxconn and ANA Airlines. Growing Replit in Japan is a rare overlap of my network and my daily practice.
texts.If you want to share something you built: I have not shipped on Replit yet - my public builds live on GitHub (https://github.com/tonydzi): claw-consensus (reproducible multi-machine agent consensus with offline demo and published evals) and verbatim-citation-gate (zero-token gate that catches fabricated RAG citations, MIT).
